item.title: Pregnant woman lost child in Marion County accident that claimed life of 5-year-old boy
item.description: State investigators say a 25-year-old woman who was 35 weeks pregnant lost her child after she was involved in a fatal motorhome accident in Marion County that also claimed the life of a 5-year-old child and injured a dozen others over the weekend.
